description: Probe set for measuring anti-hallucination tool behavior. Each probe specifies an input + the expected tool-level response. Run via benchmarks/run_hallucination_probe.py against a live MCP endpoint. Categories: A = fabricated-citation probes (should trip cite / attest_response to 'exists=false'); B = wrong-proposition probes (should trip check_claim_support to 'no|contradicts|unrelated'); C = edge cases (graceful behavior).

probes.rationale: Volume 299 doesn't exist (BGE ranges ~1-151). Tool must refuse and suggest.
Impossibly high volume.
BGer dockets don't use Z-chambers and aren't numbered 9999.
Year 3000 is impossible; X is not a valid chamber letter.
BVGer uses A/B/C/D/E/F prefixes, not Q.
MKG only has Bände 1-16 in corpus.
Wrong division — real case is 140 III 86. Suggests the correct one.

Empty input must return an error, not silently succeed.
